newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TVK 95 pre-tax profit HUF 16.18 bln-board.
newsitem.headline: TVK 95 pre-tax profit HUF 16.18 bln-board.

text.p: Hungarian chemical company Tiszai Vegyikombinat RT's 1995 pre-tax profit was 16.18 billion forints, the company said on Wednesday.
"The board has approved the company's consolidated 16.18 billion forints pre-tax profit for 1995," the company said in a statement following Wednesday's extraordinary general meeting.
The general meeting has also elected three new members to the board of directors.

The privatisation of TVK, with a registered capital of 24 billion forints, was concluded in July with a domestic public offer, after foreign and domestic investors bought 64.58 percent of its shares at 135 percent of their 1,000 forints nominal value, or $8.81, while employees bought a stake of about nine percent.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, TVK shares closed at 1,340 forints on Tuesday, down five.
